sources.title: Canadian Securities Exchange connectivity guide — December 2017

facts.label: Historical facility role
facts.value: Q9 at 100 Wellington Street hosted connectivity to the Canadian Securities Exchange. The exchange announced withdrawal of that connectivity effective 1 May 2018.

facts.label: Historical cross-connect service
facts.value: The December 2017 guide allowed colocated customers to request an in-house connection to CSE. This is historical information; the Q9 connection was scheduled to end in May 2018.
